title: The Problem of Updating Embeddings in Vector Databases
description:
Frank Liu addresses the technical challenges of updating embeddings in vector databases, the need for re-indexing, focusing on potential solutions, and the importance of research in this area. 

Watch the full episode: https://youtu.be/E4rNTYN3aIg
